apps.name: Soccer Stats
apps.subtitle: Track goals, assists, and match stats
apps.localizedDescription: Track your player’s goals, assists, and match stats across seasons, and score games live from the sideline.

versions.localizedDescription: - Set a different game length for one game, such as shorter tournament games. Edit the game and change Minutes per half; leave it blank to use the season's usual length. The game clock, live page and lock-screen clock follow it.

- The home screen groups everything by season and year (Winter 2026–27, Fall 2026, …), newest first, with that period's seasons, tournaments and other games together.
- One-off games can now be marked as a tournament game, with the tournament's name, just like games in a season.
- Tournament and friendly tags now show on one-off game results inside each team's box.
- Duplicate match now tells you it worked: the copy opens at the top with a note that you're editing the new copy.
- In the play-by-play, your player's goals now use the same green dot as the rest of the team's goals.
- In the play-by-play, teammate and opponent goals now read like your player's: "Goal · Teammate" and "Goal · " with the other team's name.

apps.name: Soccer Stats Beta
apps.subtitle: Test builds of upcoming features
apps.localizedDescription: Test builds of Soccer Stats with features that aren’t released yet. Installs alongside the normal app.

versions.localizedDescription: New Live Activity look (app name, LIVE/FINAL, logos), game clock with minutes per half, opponent logos.
Tap the live score to open the scoring screen. After Done, the final score stays on the lock screen for 30 minutes.
Fix: the live score code wasn't connected. The scoring screen now shows a small 'Live:' status next to Done.
